notes.title: Immortal Realms – Update 1.02 for Steam
notes.content:
[h1]Immortal Realms – Update 1.02 for Steam[/h1] 


[h3][i]Vampires and other creatures of the night,[/i] [/h3]

[b]Update 1.02[/b] for Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars is now available on Steam. This update applies several bug fixes and improvements, such as the option to choose between DirectX and OpenGL.  

A detailed list of these can be found below.  

Thank you for your comprehensive feedback and support thus far.  
  
[i]Your Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars team[/i]

 

[h2]Additions:[/h2] 

[list]
[*]Added the option to choose between DirectX and OpenGL. We recommend using OpenGL with AMD graphic cards if crashes have been observed. 
[*]Added localized cinematic subtitles [/list]

 

[h2]Fixed:[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed multiple crashes 
[*]Fixed multiple rare issues which caused restriction in the game progress 
[*]Fixed not being able to swap units when both armies are full 
[*]Fixed shrine effects not getting displayed on unit cards 
[*]Fixed shrine effects staying active after moving the unit away from the shrine 
[*]Fixed lord UI not getting updated after replacing an item 
[*]Fixed unit models staying upright after getting defeated in battle 
[*]Fixed warning “Armies with action points” still being displayed even if no armies have action points left 
[*]Fixed player Aspiration pop-up getting displayed for too long 
[*]Fixed Aspiration pop-up not being localized in all languages 
[*]Fixed “Blight” spell being blocked by shrine effects 
[*]Fixed “Corpse Explosion” spell being usable on targets above 33% health 
[*]Fixed flickering in game lights 
[*]Fixed being able to cast the upgraded “Blood Storm” spell after lord died 
[*]Fixed “Shady Deal” card being able to get applied multiple times for the same purchase 
[*]Fixed an exploit using the “Forbidden Knowledge” card [/list]

notes.title: Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars New Update(v1.01) released!
notes.content:
Vampires and other creatures of the night,

Here is the latest overview of all the improvements and changes that have just been released for Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars.

Thanks for all your feedback and bug reports so far. 

You will find the complete changelog down below:

[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list][*] Moroia Mission 4: The Legacy “Prowess” now reduces the cost of cards [/list]

[h3]Save game:[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where the Retreat Button blocked the player from progressing
[*] Fixed an issue when overwriting a Sandbox save
[*] Fixed an issue when loading a save in game
[*] Fixed an issue with the rename save button[/list]

[h3]UI and Visuals:[/h3]
[list]
[*] UI of the Army, Lord and Kingdom Mode now updates in real time 
[*] Aspiration rank up overlay now shows the correct rank 
[*] German Tutorial shows the correct tasks for “Items”
[*] A graphical error in Cecilia’s clothing was fixed[/list]
 
[h3]Audio:[/h3]
[list][*] Audio volume of Lords now match the audio settings[/list]

[h3]Achievements:[/h3]
[list][*] Various Achievements fixed (“Survivor”, “Last Man Standing”, “Champion Achievements”)[/list]

[h3]Further Changes: [/h3]
[list][*] Added version “1.01” to the Main Menu[/list]

notes.title: Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars unleashes Featurette uncovering final Game Details
notes.content:
Publisher Kalypso Media and developer Palindrome Interactive today shared that the 'Moroia' update for Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars is available to beta players. The update adds the third and final campaign to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1024480/Immortal_Realms_Vampire_Wars/]Steam[/url] beta and Xbox Game Preview versions of Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars ahead of its release on [b]28th August[/b]. 

The Moroia campaign follows the story of the mysterious Moroia clan, allowing players to explore and do battle on the frozen plains of Esain while learning more about the clan's bloody history.

Also available is the[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-pcMkbWUur0] fourth and final featurette [/url]filmed at Palindrome Interactive which dives into the game's story, details the inspiration for the narrative and explores the history and the bloody war between the game's three unique vampire clans. A supplementary article on the game's story and inspirations by Producer Atle Fägersten is available to[url=https://blog.playstation.com/2020/08/10/love-loss-and-treachery-inside-the-story-of-immortal-realms-vampire-wars/] read on the PlayStation Blog[/url].

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-pcMkbWUur0

If you missed any previous instalments in the Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars developer featurette series, catch up here:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jM6kJErZy5Y&t=1s]Part I - An Introduction to Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lBe6LkNvsNU&t=1s]Part II - The Gameplay and Systems of Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nel1cCqj9d0&t=5s]Part III - The Story and Inspiration of Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars[/url]

[b]Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars will launch on 28th August for Windows PC, PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch.[/b] Access to the closed beta is available up until launch for those pre-purchasing at the Microsoft Store via Xbox Game Preview.


[h3]INFORMATION[/h3]
[b]Title:[/b] [i]Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars[/i]
[b]Platforms:[/b] [i]Windows PC, PS4, Xbox One,
Nintendo Switch™ [/i] 
[b]Developer:[/b] [i]Palindrome Interactive[/i]
[b]Genre:[/b][i] Empire management/turn-based strategy[/i]
[b]Release date:[/b] [i]28/08/2020 - Windows PC, PS4,
Xbox One, Nintendo Switch™[/i]
[b]Hashtag:[/b] [i]#ImmortalRealms[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35196448/b681bf7004b431dcd9eb5b8fb9096fd6cae2989d.jpg[/img]

[h3]About Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars:[/h3]
 
Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars is an engaging strategy game set in a dark vampire world in turmoil, that combines empire management and turn-based vampiric combat. Descend into a mythical world filled with horrors, legends and compelling gothic epos paired with a challenging game experience.


[h3]Features:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]The truth unfolds:[/b] Discover the secrets of Nemire, and experience an enthralling story spanning 12 meticulously crafted missions and four unique environments, from the perspective of four mighty vampire lords, each with their own goals and agendas
[*] [b]Discover the bloodlines: [/b]Command one of three unique vampire clans with distinctive units, powers, gameplay mechanics and characters. Play as the bloodthirsty Dracul, monstrous Nosfernus, or mysterious Moroia
[*] [b]Vampiric powers:[/b] Powerful spells and abilities enhance the gameplay and provide a refreshing take on the genre. Each clan and vampire lord has access to their own set of abilities, which can be synergized into powerful combinations
[*] [b]Strategy & tactics: [/b]Command legendary armies, recruit new units and unlock crucial technologies in the strategic Kingdom Mode, and put tactical skills to the test in the action-packed Battle Mode
[*] [b]Varied content:[/b] Choose from three different gameplay modes: the story-driven Campaign, the open-world Sandbox, and the hard-fought Skirmish.
[/list]

notes.title: Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars Beta update ‘Rise of the Nosfernus’ released!
notes.content:
Vampires and other creatures of the night,

Here is the latest overview of all the additions, improvements and changes that have just been released for the beta.

Thanks for all your feedback and bug reports so far - we hope you continue to enjoy playing the beta!

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list][*][b]The complete Nosfernus campaign is now unlocked (all 4 missions)[/b]
[*]Dracul Missions 2 and 3 have been improved with additional dialogue and other adjustments, to add more depth.
[*]Sandbox and Skirmish Modes are now fully unlocked
[list][*]This means: All clans, all maps, all units. Literally everything can be accessed now in Skirmish and Sandbox modes.[/list]
[*]Added: A 2D overview map, accessible through the “M” key
[*]Added: Siege maps for battles taking place on keeps (no walls but unique looks and blocker layouts)
[*]Added: Aspirations battle-mechanic for lords, to provide the player with randomized optional tasks in battle[/list]

[h3]More[/h3]
[list][*]Various bug fixes and minor improvements
[list][*][i]As we have gone through many iterations and versions, with lots of bugfixes for both the PC beta, Xbox One Game Preview and the final release version of the game. As such, there are too many changes, bugfixes and list them all in just one changelog.[/i][/list][/list]


[h3]Important information for PC Steam beta-players[/h3]
[i][u]Please note: [/u][/i]
[i]Stay tuned for more updates and please remember to report any bugs or issues directly to the developers by hitting the “F1” key to access the in-game report function.[/i]
To test the latest changes and improvements we made to two Dracul-missions, the respective missions of the Dracul-campaign need to be started anew.
Old savegames will not receive/include the latest improvements we made for this specific campaign.
